digits.description: icao says Tree, Fower, Fife, Niner; plain says Three, Four, Five, Nine.

direction.description: spell turns text into code words; decode turns code words back into text.

markCase.description: Prefix each letter with Capital or Lowercase.

spelling.description: icao prints Alfa and Juliett as published; common prints Alpha and Juliet.

text.description: Text to spell, or code words to decode (e.g. 'Alfa Bravo / Charlie').
